name: hud_ui_chat_message_stack_constructor
description: HudUiChatMessageStack::Constructor builds the four chat-message HudUiPanel rows, installs the chat-stack ftable, links children, and applies chat row color/font/position defaults.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a HUD text-stack source-cluster pass because the retail body uses MSVC_EH_ArrayConstructor and EH cleanup shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bd2d0 validates HudUiContainer base construction, MSVC_EH_ArrayConstructor over four HudUiPanel rows via 0x4bd100, chat-stack ftable installation, child linking, Arial font setup, x=0x140, y values 0x159, 0x147, 0x135, and 0x123, text colors 0x00996a00 and 0x0095c7ff, text dirty state, and shadow defaults.
0x4bd100 HudUiPanel::ConstructorDefaultThunk is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_panel_constructor_default_thunk.

The native text-stack constructor smoke calls HudUiChatMessageStack::Constructor and verifies the chat-stack ftable, four row ftable identities, row x/y coordinates, chat row colors, text dirty and shadow fields, child head/tail linkage, and font creation.
